observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== port listening ==="; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep 5173; echo "=== stability: 5 quick requests ==="; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 "http://localhost:5173/"); echo "req $i -> $code"; done; echo "=== node_modules count ==="; ls node_modules | wc -l; echo "=== metrics route links in UI ==="; grep -rn 'href="/metrics\|href={"/metrics\|/metrics' src/app --include="*.tsx" | grep -i href | head
